status: complete: step 1 of 3 (spec-forms-core.json and spec-rich-inputs-files.json) implemented in packages/angular with tests; build and whole package test run pass

deviations.what: (click)="guardClick($event)", a method that prevents the default only while read-only, instead of the inline (click)="readOnly && $event.preventDefault()"
deviations.why: An Angular listener whose expression returns false cancels the event: the inline form cancelled every click on an editable checkbox and file input. Rendered result and behaviour are as specified.

deviations.what: HwValueControl.ngDoCheck marks the control for check when the state of its hw-field changed (subclasses with their own ngDoCheck call super)
deviations.why: Angular 22 components are OnPush by default: a control that reads the field in getters is otherwise not rendered again when only the field changes (error, required, hint, label).

deviations.what: The name check (texts.need(label) unless named) runs in ngDoCheck of hw-toggle-group, hw-search-field and hw-file-dropzone, not through a getter read by the template
deviations.why: fieldLabel reads `label` directly; the check runs once per pass either way and the rendered result is the same.

deviations.what: syncValidity clears submissionInvalid when the required constraint no longer applies (!constrained), not when input.validity.valid
deviations.why: The input is also natively required and the text of a new selection is rendered after syncValidity runs, so validity.valid is still false at that moment and aria-invalid would stay after a valid selection. Tag input and multi-select use validity.valid as specified.

deviations.what: With a one-way [open] the list closes after Escape and openChange(false) is emitted once; the case text "the list stays open" is not asserted for Angular
deviations.why: perAdapter.angular and convention controlled-and-observable-state: Angular has no controlled mode, a written value is the initial state and the component then updates its own field (the same exception forms-core records for RESET-05).

deviations.item: rich-inputs-1, E01, R27, files-10, files-6 (templates of the rich inputs)
deviations.what: The inputs use the shared controlAria constant (aria-label, labelledBy, descriptionIds, invalid) instead of the hand-written [attr.aria-label]="ariaLabel" [attr.aria-labelledby]="ariaLabelledby" and error || ariaInvalid || submissionInvalid; hw-pin-input and hw-file-dropzone override get invalid() to add incomplete / rejectedFiles
deviations.why: forms-core sharedApi.forOtherClusters tells the other clusters to use the constants; outside an hw-field the rendered attributes are identical, inside one the control is also labelled and invalid through the field.

deviations.what: Text field and number field syncDom call shown.force() and apply the value at once; range slider syncDom narrows lower.max / upper.min again after writing both values
deviations.why: Held, shown and submitted value then agree in the reset callback itself, without waiting for the next render; Angular does not rewrite an unchanged [max] binding.

deviations.what: remove(tag, button?) takes the activated remove button as its optional second argument (the reconciled prepareRemovalFocus mechanism), not an index
deviations.why: The amendment replaced the index arithmetic by prepareRemovalFocus(box, button, ...); the public name remove and its first argument are unchanged.

deviations.what: inputChanged calls update only when the normalised code changed
deviations.why: PININPUT-02 requires that one more typed character on a full code notifies nothing; the spec text calls update unconditionally.

deviations.what: hw-toggle-group.ngOnInit turns a non-array value of a multiple group into an array before the initial value is captured
deviations.why: The reset target of a multiple group without an initial value must be [] and never the default "".

deviations.what: hw-multi-select reports (focused)/(blurred) as a group (focusin/focusout on its fieldset)
deviations.why: It is a fieldset of several controls; forms-core lists the group rule for fieldset controls and the rich-inputs spec names no rule for it.

deviations.what: packages/angular/README.md states the removal of the TagInput Add button and of the input for its text without the literal input name
deviations.why: RENAME-01 requires that addLabel does not appear in the Angular README, while the readme note asks for the removal line; the exact name belongs in CHANGELOG.md (not owned here): hw-tag-input addLabel removed, delete the attribute.
